딸꾹! 이 집에서 술 냄새가 솔솔 나더라고.\n에일이지? 꿀술이지? 다:

…Can't I drink with you? I pick a fine bottle.
히히! 역시 말이 통한다니까.\n자, 이거 받아. 나를 부르는 카드야.\:
Hehe! I knew we'd get along.
Here, take this. It's a card that calls me.

Ahh, this hearth is lovely.

또 왔지롱! 딸꾹.\n술 냄새 따라왔더니 또 여기네.\n이 집은 술이 부:
I'm baaack! Hic.
Followed the smell of drink and here I am again.
This house just calls to the bottle.
Witch, it's me, Erin!
…How many cups is this today? Hic.

gets rained on, knocks on the door, I open it….

있지! 마음만은 늘 갚고 있어.\n주머니가 마음을 못 따라와서 그렇지.\:
